profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, trading as LUMN. Its website describes the company as providing AI-ready networking and secure cloud solutions, including a global fiber network, secure networking, edge cloud, and AI-ready infrastructure. The site says Lumen is "the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy" and highlights a programmable, consumption-based network with diverse 100G paths and automatic failover.

The company's site presents customer examples: Arctic Glacier used built-in automation to replace manual operations; the New York Yankees use Lumen's network for real-time scalability between Yankee Stadium and Tampa; American Family Care uses a private, low-latency network for AI workloads; and Prometheus Hyperscale anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady. No specific product names are provided.

The company has 57 legal exposure entries in Louisiana, though no specific lawsuits are listed. Its SEC CIK is 0000018926. No MCP servers are listed.
